title.text: BF26 English 1 Unit Test — 45 minutes — answer key

instructions.text: Vocabulary: Write the Word or Phrase (24 points)

Complete each sentence with the word or phrase from the chapter 1–2 vocabulary list. The Swedish cue gives the meaning. Use the list form and write the whole missing word or phrase. Check your spelling. Each gap is worth 1 point.
For each definition, select the correct word or phrase. Each correct match is worth 1 point.
Read each sentence. Choose one option that explains the bold word or phrase as it is used in that sentence.
Type only the missing word or the replacement requested in each item. Do not copy the whole sentence.
Choose one answer for each question.

segments.text: 1. This job requires the
(förmåga) to work well with other people.
2. After the flood, the family faced a
(påtvingad) move.
3. The family needed time alone to
(sörja) after their loss.
4. I was
(häpen) when I won tickets to the final.
5. Regular breaks can
(lindra) stress during a busy day.
6. The cake fell onto the floor.
(självfallet), nobody wanted a slice.
7. After several lessons, I am
(först nu) starting to understand the rules.
8. Even a little smoke can
(utlösa) the alarm.
9. The store sells
(en rad av) tools for different jobs.
10. Cars are
(ständigt) passing our house, even late at night.
11. Noise can
(påverka) your concentration while you study.
12. You do not need to
(oroa sig) about the cost; the trip is free.
13. I sent a message to
(lugna) my parents that I was safe.
14. The
(ihållande) rain kept us indoors for three days.
15. Setting up the new computer was
(problemfritt); everything worked the first time.
16. The driver made a
(plötslig) stop when a dog ran into the road.
17. When I pressed the button, the screen lit up
(ögonblickligen).
18. The group discussed
(olika) ways to solve the problem.
19. The jacket looked thin.
(emellertid), it kept me warm.
20. The stain on the white shirt was
(märkbar) from across the room.
21. Can you
(känna igen) this song from its first few seconds?
22. Her
(återhämtningsförmåga) helped her start again after she lost her job.
23. After a hard year, we hope to
(repa sig) and enjoy school again.
24. A strong fence can
(förhindra) animals from reaching the road.
